nodes.label: Paragraph Reformatter Feature
nodes.description: Feature specification for paragraph reformatter Modelfile that transforms unstructured speech-to-text output into well-organized paragraphs

nodes.label: Paragraph Reformatter Implementation Plan
nodes.description: Implementation plan for creating Modelfile-reformat that structures transcription text into paragraphs

nodes.label: Paragraph Reformatter Data Model
nodes.description: Conceptual input/output model for stateless text transformation tool

nodes.label: Modelfile-reformat
nodes.description: Ollama Modelfile that performs paragraph reformatting on continuous text

nodes.label: Content Preservation Requirement
nodes.description: Critical requirement that reformatter must preserve 100% of original text without additions, deletions, or modifications
nodes.rationale: Users need to trust that their transcripts remain accurate and complete, especially for factual content, technical terms, and precise numbers

nodes.label: Paragraph Detection Logic
nodes.description: Logic for determining where to insert paragraph breaks based on topic shifts, speaker transitions, temporal shifts, logical conclusions, and list structures
nodes.rationale: Natural reading progression requires cohesive grouping of related ideas with clear boundaries at topic/time/speaker transitions

nodes.label: Ollama Modelfile System
nodes.description: Configuration system for running local LLMs with custom prompts and parameters

nodes.label: Prompt Engineering Approach
nodes.description: Explicit prompt engineering to constrain model behavior and ensure content preservation through system prompts and low temperature
nodes.rationale: Low temperature (0.1) produces deterministic outputs while explicit instructions prevent the model from adding, removing, or modifying content beyond paragraph breaks

nodes.label: Paragraph Reformatter Test Suite
nodes.description: Comprehensive validation test suite with 8 test cases covering continuous text, various lengths, technical content, factual data, and edge cases

nodes.label: Parakeet MLX
nodes.description: Speech-to-text system leveraging Apple Metal Performance Shaders for efficient neural network processing

nodes.label: Transcriber Pipeline
nodes.description: Three-stage audio processing pipeline: Import → Transcribe → Process

nodes.label: DJI Mic 2
nodes.description: Portable recording device with dual-channel wireless capabilities for capturing meetings, interviews, lectures

nodes.label: Validation Tools
nodes.description: Bash scripts for automated content preservation and quality verification

nodes.label: Process Raw Transcript Text
nodes.description: Transform unstructured text output from speech-to-text into well-organized paragraphs

nodes.label: Handle Various Text Lengths
nodes.description: Process text of varying lengths from short notes to lengthy transcripts without quality degradation

nodes.label: Preserve Original Meaning
nodes.description: Improve structure without altering, removing, or adding content beyond formatting

nodes.label: Opening Sentence Removal Bug
nodes.description: LLM initially removed introductory meta sentences like 'This is a sample text...'
nodes.rationale: Large language models sometimes interpret meta sentences as instructions rather than content. Fixed by lowering temperature to 0.1 and adding explicit instruction with examples to preserve all opening sentences

nodes.label: llama3.3:70b
nodes.description: Base language model used for paragraph reformatting

nodes.label: Requirements Checklist
nodes.description: Specification quality validation checklist confirming completeness and readiness

nodes.label: Constitution Compliance Check
nodes.description: Validation that paragraph reformatter complies with project core principles
nodes.rationale: Feature adds optional enhancement tool within existing pipeline without modifying core architecture. Maintains CLI-first interface, uses existing Ollama dependency, and enhances AI capabilities while preserving state-tracked file processing
